rachats.citation: IBM acquired Truven Health Analytics for $2.6 billion, as the company expanded into healthcare analytics and artificial intelligence.
IBM announced its acquisition of Red Hat for $34 billion in October 2018 and completed the deal in July 2019.
IBM announced the acquisition of the enterprise software company Turbonomic for $1.5 billion.
IBM announced it would acquire Software AG's StreamSets and webMethods platforms for Euro 2.13 billion ($2.33 billion).
IBM announced a deal to acquire data-infrastructure company Confluent for approximately $11 billion.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
